messages:
ashley-g: quick sync after the postmortem  We need a tight remediation plan for the kv cache leak + OOMs. I9m listing concrete tasks; please react or reply with owner + ETA. Keep updates here so we can fold into the follow-up doc.

nina: I9ll build a repro harness that replays traffic patterns we saw (long tail requests + small ops). Will also add a synthetic generator that mirrors key-size distribution. ETA 48h.

sam-b: I'll add jemalloc stats export and heap sampling (heaptrack / pprof equivalent) to the runtime image. Plan: instrument canary and collect 2 hours of traces. ETA 72h.

jiro: Temp mitigation: enforce per-process soft memory caps and auto-restart on OOM. I'll push a systemd override and a k8s pod OOMKill policy change to canary. Rolling in 2h unless objections.

ashley-g: +1 to that. Please name the PRs like "runtime: kv-leak-mitigations-1792" and link them here.

ops-bot: Alert created: "kv_cache_tail_memory_spike" -> notify #eng-runtime + @oncall after 2/5 spikes in 15m.

infra-bot: Dataset snapshot request filed: DS-2027. Can provision one replica-sized staging clone in 36-48h.

nina: For the generator, I'll include a small flag to vary object sizes and TTLs. Will commit under tooling/kv-replay.

sam-b: Profiling commands I'll use (example): ```LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libjemalloc.so MALLOC_CONF=utrace:true ./inference_runtime --config /etc/rt.conf &
# then run heap profiler collector``` Will attach runbook.

jiro: systemd override snippet I'll deploy: ```[Service]
MemoryLimit=12G
OOMScoreAdjust=-800``` Putting in draft PR now.

ashley-g: Ownership & short deadlines: nina (repro + generator) - 48h; sam-b (heap + jemalloc) - 72h; jiro (soft caps) - 2h deploy canary. infra-bot DS-2027 for staging clone - 48h. ops-bot alert - done.

nina: If infra can9t clone full dataset quickly, I9ll generate a heavier synthetic snapshot and share script. Marking DS fallback plan.

sam-b: After traces, I9ll produce a short report with hotspots and allocation stacks. If we see heavy iterator retention, I9ll propose small API-level fix (release buffers earlier).

jiro: Will monitor memory graphs and annotate the incident board. If soft cap causes too many restarts, we9ll revert and try oom_score_adj less aggressive.

ashley-g: Thanks. Next steps: owners post PR links here and tag when artifacts (heap dumps, flamegraphs, replay logs) are uploaded to s3://inference-debug/dumps/<thread_ts>. We9ll meet 15m after initial artifacts are available. :white_check_mark:
